[P1] Preserve the lane when the eager result only matches speculative state

`queue.lastRenderedState` can be written by an unfinished render, so an eager bailout does not establish equality with committed state. Start a transition that renders `true` and yields while the committed value is still `false`, then enqueue another transition `setValue(true)`: it takes this bailout path. Clearing its lane makes it eligible during an interrupting synchronous render, which applies its cached eager state and commits `true` immediately. Retaining the transition lane keeps urgent output at `false` and allows the deferred update to apply later. Please preserve the deferred update's priority semantics and add the interrupted-render case before merging.

might not be all that much better but you can apparently pass a signal to addEventListener. when it aborts the listener gets removed. We could then just model the render as having a lifetime and we always abort the renderlifetime controller when the render completes. functionaly it's the same thing though so maybe not worth it?
Nice idea, that made the cleanup much simpler. It also automatically handles the cancelled stream case.

We should make search asynchronous.

When the search input is updated, we should update it synchronously, e.g. just calling `setSearchTextState(text)`. But finding matches should be done in a transition, because otherwise it may block the update that will change the input text.

Keep controlled input updates sync, and put other updates in a transition.

Done. The controlled input now updates synchronously (setSearchTextState(text)), and the match computation is deferred: searchResults is derived from useDeferredValue(searchText), so the tree walk runs at transition priority and never blocks the input update. I went with useDeferredValue rather than startTransition since searchResults is a derived value — it's the transition-priority tool for derived data, and it keeps results scoped to the current commit for free (the memo re-derives on commit change). Selecting the current match now reacts to the deferred results.
